provenance.note: At least 15 scored shots per distance (D.23.1.17, the announcement may differ), 2 sighters (D.23.1.16). The book prints the face table for 700 to 1000 m (800 to 1200 yd) only; it names no face for shorter distances and leaves 5-ring or 10-ring faces to the announcement.
